channel.title: OSIRIS Blog
channel.description: Stories from development, updates from the community, and thoughts on open research information.

item.title: What the Barcelona Declaration means for research institutions in practice
item.description: Open research information takes more than a statement of commitment. How institutions can rethink infrastructure, research assessment and the recognition of diverse contributions to research.

item.title: ORCID, ROR, DOI and more: a guide to identifiers
item.description: Why unique identifiers are essential for reliable research information, which identifiers you should know, and how OSIRIS uses them to import, link and deduplicate records.

item.title: OSIRIS Solutions Supports euroCRIS 2026 Conference
item.description: OSIRIS Solutions is proud to announce its support for the euroCRIS 2026 conference, highlighting our commitment to open, interoperable research information systems and collaboration within the research community.

item.title: OSIRIS Solutions officially supports the Barcelona Declaration
item.description: OSIRIS Solutions is now an official supporter of the Barcelona Declaration on Open Research Information. This is a statement of our commitment to transparency, openness and collaborative research infrastructures.
